items.q: I don't understand programming at all. Can I use this product?
items.a: Absolutely! Our product is designed to be easy for non-technical users. You just need to prepare product introduction text and images, and with simple visual configuration, you can set up a professional product showcase website in minutes.

items.q: What custom features does the website support?
items.a: The standard version supports basic theme customization, bilingual switching, mobile adaptation, etc.; the advanced version also supports custom colors, fonts, layouts, multilingual expansion, advanced animation effects, and PWA offline access, among other features. All features can be easily configured through a visual interface.

items.q: How is the website's loading speed and performance?
items.a: We use the latest Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 technology stack, ensuring excellent performance through code splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and other methods. The advanced version also supports PWA technology for instant loading, making your website faster.

items.q: How can I ensure my website is indexed by search engines?
items.a: We have a complete SEO optimization plan built-in. The standard version provides basic SEO configuration; the advanced version supports custom meta tags, multilingual SEO, automatic sitemap generation, and other advanced features to help your website achieve better search engine rankings.

items.q: How do I get technical support after purchase?
items.a: The standard version provides email technical support with a response within 24 hours; advanced version users enjoy priority technical support with a response within 2 hours. We also provide detailed user documentation and video tutorials to help you get started quickly. If you encounter issues, you can also join the user community for discussions.
